# Compixor AI

> Free, 100% private document and media processing toolkit running in client-side RAM with zero permanent storage.

Compixor AI is a client-side document and media manipulation platform designed for speed and uncompromising privacy. It processes documents and photos locally in the user's browser memory using WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript, ensuring sensitive files never touch external servers or permanent disks.

## Platform Information

- [Compixor AI](https://compixor-ai.cloud/): Official platform homepage and tools catalog
- [About Compixor AI](https://compixor-ai.cloud/about): Platform mission, client-side WebAssembly architecture, and engineering details
- [Privacy Policy](https://compixor-ai.cloud/privacy): Strict zero-server retention policy, in-memory processing details, and security guarantees
- [Terms of Service](https://compixor-ai.cloud/terms): Platform usage terms, 100% user copyright retention, and commercial use permissions
- [Guides & Blog](https://compixor-ai.cloud/blog): Step-by-step guides on PDF compression, password protection, passport photos, and QR codes
- [Contact Support](https://compixor-ai.cloud/contact): Technical support, bug reporting, and feature inquiries

## Tools Suite

- [PDF Compressor](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/pdf-compressor): In-browser vector stream optimization, custom size reduction to 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB with native text preservation.
- [PDF Merge & Split](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/pdf-organizer): Visual drag-and-drop page organizer, combine multiple PDFs or split custom page ranges with zero watermark.
- [Add Watermark](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/add-watermark): Stamp custom vector text or transparent logo images onto PDF documents with opacity, rotation, and page range controls.
- [Remove Watermark](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/remove-watermark): Dual-engine digital stream filtering and interactive visual bounding box stamp eraser for clean PDF output.
- [Protect PDF](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/protect-pdf): Client-side AES-256 password encryption and granular restriction controls for printing, editing, and copying.
- [Unlock PDF](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/unlock-pdf): In-browser decryption to remove passwords and permission restrictions from owned PDFs with zero uploads.
- [Word Compressor](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/word-compressor): Re-compresses embedded images in .docx archives while keeping XML layouts, tables, and styles intact.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/passport-photo): AI-driven portrait background removal, official biometric dimension presets (Pakistan NADRA 35x45mm, US Visa 2x2", UK/Schengen), and 300 DPI printable sheets.
- [Full DP Maker](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/full-dp-maker): 1:1 square canvas creator for WhatsApp and Instagram with HD blurred backgrounds and zero forced cropping.
- [QR Code Generator](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/qr-generator): Permanent static QR code maker for URLs, WiFi credentials, WhatsApp links, and vCards with vector SVG and 4K PNG exports.
- [PDF to Word Converter](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/pdf-to-word): High-fidelity conversion from digital or scanned PDFs to editable Microsoft Word (.docx) documents with OCR for English, Urdu, and Arabic.
- [Image to Word Converter](https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/img-to-word): Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, or scanned image files into fully editable Word (.docx) documents using neural OCR across 10+ languages.

## Optional
